_: WHAT A HULL IS MADE OF — the 건조소's recipes, one per ship class.
_why: Authored here and guarded, for the same reason data/fittings.json is: a recipe that lives only inside a migration is exactly the drift world-guard exists to kill.
_where_from: Materials come out of the WAREHOUSE in the yard's own city (0070), never out of a hold. A nau wants more timber than any ship afloat could carry, and that is the point: you ferry it in over several voyages and leave it ashore. It is what makes a warehouse worth having.
_ducats: The ducat figure is the yard's LABOUR, not the price of a ship. ship_classes.build_cost is what a hull would cost if you simply bought one; here you bring the materials and pay for the work, which is roughly a quarter of it.

hulls.note: A coaster. Two fittings and a stack of deal boards - the hull a house builds first.
The lateen caravel: weatherly, and she wants a proper rudder and a headsail to prove it.
Four hundred tuns of hold. Live oak below the waterline, copper over it, and a year of somebody's life.
